overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（5 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（4 篇）、公司金融（1 篇）。方法上以回归分析、实验方法为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、Semantic Scholar（5 篇）。

papers.title: Calibration-Induced Degeneracy in LLM Financial Forecasting: An Audit-Trailed Case Study on Next-Day Market Risk
papers.abstract: Costly LLM features matter only if calibration lets them affect the forecast. We document a failure of this link in a next-day risk study of two broad-market funds. Full-history scoring preceded the 2022 calibration. Calibration then set all four LLM weights to zero. The 856 later scores therefore could not affect the evaluation. We call this calibration-induced degeneracy. Allowing signed weights reactivated all four mappings. None improved forecasts after familywise correction. By contrast, a near-zero-cost headline count reduced SPY variance-forecast loss by 0.001720 (95 percent familywise interval: [0.000719, 0.002830]). The cheap baseline is therefore a critical diagnostic. We propose a calibration-viability checkpoint. Fit the mapping, perturb the feature over prespecified calibration values, and require a meaningful forecast response before acquiring holdout features. The check uses no holdout outcomes. Here, it would have stopped the paid full-history inference phase.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】昂贵的大型语言模型（LLM）特征只有在校准过程中能够影响预测结果时才具有实际意义。我们在对两只广泛交易的市场基金进行的次日风险研究中发现了这种关联的失效现象：在2022年的校准之前，这些模型已经完成了基于全部历史数据的评分；校准之后，所有四个LLM模型的权重都被设置为零，因此后续的评分结果无法对预测结果产生任何影响。我们将这种现象称为“校准引起的退化”。允许模型权重保留符号后，虽然四个模型的映射关系得以恢复，但在经过家族间（familywise）校正后，没有一个模型的预测性能得到改善。相比之下，一个成本几乎为零的指标（即新闻标题数量）将标准普尔500指数（SPY）的方差预测误差降低了0.001720（家族间置信区间为[0.000719, 0.002830]）。因此，使用低成本的基础模型是一个关键的诊断工具。我们建议引入一个校准可行性检查机制：首先拟合模型映射关系，然后在预设的校准范围内调整特征参数，并在获取保留数据之前确保模型能够产生有意义的预测结果。该检查机制不依赖于任何保留数据的分析结果；如果模型在调整后仍无法产生有效的预测，应立即终止基于全部历史数据的推理过程。。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Dynamic Portfolio Optimization under CVaR Constraints
papers.abstract: We study continuous-time dynamic portfolio optimization under a Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) constraint on the investor's terminal loss. For a general class of convex trading objectives, we exploit the auxiliary-threshold representation of CVaR to establish the existence of an optimal strategy and strong duality without requiring market completeness. These results motivate a dual-based nested bisection--golden-search algorithm over the threshold and Lagrangian multiplier, where the inner iterations reduce to standard unconstrained stochastic control problems. We prove that the resulting strategies converge to the optimal control as the number of iterations tends to infinity. Numerical experiments recover the Merton policy when the risk constraint is nonbinding. When the constraint is binding, the optimal strategy becomes state dependent: the investor reduces risky exposure following adverse outcomes but preserves, and near maturity may increase, exposure following favorable outcomes. Thus, a terminal CVaR constraint produces an asymmetric reallocation across states rather than uniform de-risking. Nontraded endowment risk amplifies the conservative adjustment, whereas price impact lowers desired positions and adjustment speeds.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们研究了在投资者终端损失受到条件风险价值（CVaR）约束下的连续时间动态投资组合优化问题。对于一类一般的凸交易目标，我们利用CVaR的辅助阈值表示方法，在不要求市场完备性的前提下证明了最优策略的存在性及其强对偶性。这些结果启发我们开发了一种基于对偶性的嵌套二分-黄金搜索算法，用于求解阈值和拉格朗日乘数；其中内部迭代过程可简化为标准的无约束随机控制问题。我们证明了随着迭代次数的增加，所得策略会逐渐收敛到最优控制策略。数值实验表明：当风险约束不具约束力时，算法能够得到Merton策略；当约束具有约束力时，最优策略会依赖于具体状态：投资者在不利结果发生时会减少风险敞口，而在有利结果发生时会保持或增加风险敞口（尤其是在临近到期时）。因此，终端CVaR约束会导致不同状态之间的资产重新配置，而非均匀的风险降低。未交易的资产风险会加剧投资者的保守调整行为，而价格波动则会降低投资者对理想投资组合的追求程度并减缓调整速度。。研究方法：实验方法、随机过程、优化方法。

papers.title: Analysis of the Implementation of the Coretax System to Improve Efficiency and Effectiveness
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: The coretax system is a comprehensive tax management system introduced by the Directorate General of Taxes starting January 1, 2025. With this system, all Corporate and Individual Taxpayers perform tax calculations, payments, and reporting on a unified platform, replacing multiple earlier systems like DJP Online and Web e-Invoice. This study seeks to assess the degree of efficiency and effectiveness of utilizing the coretax system from the viewpoint of the user. The employed method is descriptive quantitative, utilizing a survey approach through a five-point Likert scale questionnaire administered to 30 participants, which include tax consultants, individual taxpayers, and employees from the company tax division. Data analysis employs descriptive statistics, including mean values, percentages, and frequency distribution, following validity and reliability assessments. The research findings are expected to demonstrate how much the coretax system can reduce time, expenses, and energy while enhancing the precision and effectiveness of tax reporting.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】“CoreTax系统”是由土耳其税务局（Dirección General de Impuestos）于2025年1月1日推出的综合性税收管理系统。在该系统下，所有企业和个人纳税人均需在统一的平台上完成税务计算、缴纳税款及提交纳税申报。该系统取代了此前使用的多个旧系统，例如DJP Online和Web e-Invoice。本研究旨在从用户的角度评估CoreTax系统的使用效率与效果。研究采用描述性定量分析方法，通过五点李克特量表（Likert scale）对30名受访者进行了调查，受访者包括税务顾问、个人纳税人以及公司税务部门的员工。数据分析过程中运用了描述性统计方法（如平均值、百分比和频率分布），并在调查前对问卷的有效性和可靠性进行了评估。研究结果有望揭示CoreTax系统在节省时间、降低成本的同时，如何提升税务申报的准确性和效率。。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: The Effect of Capital Structure and Working Capital Turnover on Profitability in Manufacturing Companies: An Empirical Study of the LQ45 Index
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: This research aims to examine and analyze the effect of capital structure (Debt to Equity Ratio) and working capital efficiency (Working Capital Turnover) on profitability (Return on Assets). The population in this study is manufacturing companies consistently listed in the LQ45 index of the Indonesia Stock Exchange during the 2022-2025 period. Sampling was conducted using a purposive sampling technique, resulting in 48 observation units from 12 companies over four years. The data were analyzed using the Panel Data Regression method. Based on the Chow Test and Hausman Test results, the Fixed Effect Model (FEM) was selected as the most appropriate estimation model. The results show that the Debt to Equity Ratio (DER) has a significant positive effect on profitability, supporting the relevance of the Trade-Off Theory regarding the benefits of tax shields. Conversely, Working Capital Turnover (WCTO) has no significant effect on profitability. This indicates that overly rapid turnover of receivables and inventory potentially generates hidden costs that can reduce estimated operational profits.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本研究旨在探讨资本结构（债务权益比）和营运资金效率（营运资金周转率）对制造业公司盈利能力（总资产回报率）的具体影响。

🔬 研究方法：研究选取了2022-2025年期间印尼证交所LQ45指数中的12家制造业公司，采用判断抽样法获取48个观测值，并运用面板数据回归模型进行分析。

📊 核心发现：研究发现债务权益比（DER）对盈利能力有显著的正向影响，支持权衡理论；而营运资金周转率（WCTO）对盈利能力没有显著影响。

💡 应用价值：该研究证实了债务融资的税收抵免优势，并警示过快的营运资金周转可能带来隐性成本，为制造业企业的财务决策提供理论依据。

papers.title: Characterizations of continuous adequate objective functions for ordinal or interval scaled data
papers.abstract: Objective functions (goodness criteria which have to be optimized) that are considered, for instance, in cluster analysis, factor analysis, (linear) structural equation modeling, (linear) regression, multidimensional scaling, choice theory, and utility theory, must be {\em adequate}, i.e. carefully adapted to the structure of the observed data. Adequateness of an objective function means, in our terminology, that (certain) transformations of its arguments, e.g. changes in the unit measures of the quantities involved, do not influence the solutions of the optimization procedure. In this paper we concentrate our attention on affine strictly increasing transformations and we also incorporate the case of continuous adequate objective functions accordingly. The characterization of adequate dissimilarity coefficients for interval scaled data shows the appropriateness of the concept of adequateness that is developed in this paper.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：论文旨在研究在聚类分析、回归分析等优化问题中，什么样的目标函数是“充分”的，即能够适应数据结构的优化标准。

🔬 研究方法：研究重点关注仿射严格递增变换，并针对序数或区间尺度数据，对连续充分性目标函数进行了特征刻画。

📊 核心发现：研究结果表明，对区间尺度数据的充分性距离系数进行特征刻画，验证了所提出的“充分性”概念的适用性。

💡 应用价值：该研究有助于确保在结构方程模型、回归分析等金融与经济学模型中，优化结果不受数据单位或度量变化的影响。

papers.title: The Reconfiguration Premium: Co-movement Structure as an Unspanned Dimension of the Variance Risk Premium
papers.abstract: Hedge ratios, factor models and diversified portfolios all rest on an estimate of which firms move together. That estimate is not stable: firms migrate between the groupings the market treats as coherent, and when enough migrate the organizing axes of the cross-section turn. We measure the rate of that turning as the mean squared sine of the principal angles between subdominant eigenspaces of consecutive twelve-month S&P 500 correlation matrices. A typical month rewrites a fifth of the structure and carries four-fifths forward. That rate is priced: it couples to the aggregate variance risk premium at t = 5.40, no level measure correlates above 0.32, and the implied-correlation surface spans at most 6.7 percent of it. Only the persistent component is priced - the premium compensates the pace of revision, not the distance traveled. The mechanism is prepayment: implied variance rises on impact, volatility follows two to three quarters later (simulated-null p < 0.03 at h = 1-9), and the premium converges as it arrives. Three pre-registered boundaries hold: no timing alpha, no crash protection, and a downside version inseparable from intensity. The premium is, in part, rent on exposure held over a map still being redrawn.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】对冲比率、因子模型以及多元化投资组合的构建都依赖于对哪些公司会共同变动的估计。然而，这一估计并不稳定：公司会在市场认为具有内在关联的各类群体之间迁移；当足够多的公司发生迁移时，这些群体的划分轴就会发生变化。我们通过计算连续12个月标准普尔500指数相关矩阵的次级特征空间之间的主角度的均方正弦值来衡量这种变化的速率。通常情况下，一个月的时间足以改变原有结构的五分之一，并将四分之三的结构延续到下个月。这一变化速率在市场中得到了体现：它与总方差风险溢价之间存在关联（相关系数为5.40），没有任何其他指标的相关性超过0.32；此外，隐含的相关性分布范围最多仅占总方差风险溢价的6.7%。市场中真正得到体现的只是这种变化的持续性——风险溢价实际上是对这种变化频率的补偿，而非对变化幅度的补偿。其背后的机制可以理解为“预付效应”：当变化发生时，隐含的方差会立即上升，随后波动性会在两到三个季度后显现出来（在各种模拟情景下，这一效应的显著性水平p<0.03）；随着时间的推移，风险溢价会逐渐趋于稳定。有三个关键特征始终成立：不存在与时间选择相关的超额收益（即“时机选择优势”），也没有专门的“崩盘保护机...。研究方法：横截面分析、因子模型。

papers.title: A Privacy Budgeting Framework for Online Experimentation
papers.abstract: Firms perform online experiments with multi-armed bandits to personalize what consumers are shown while balancing exploration and exploitation. However, third-parties can infer consumers' underlying segments from observing which banners, ads, or recommendations consumers receive. To control this inference, we propose a privacy risk budget that firms can set ex ante to bound such third party belief updating using differential privacy. To spend this privacy risk budget, we propose two strategies: a constant privacy risk strategy and a dynamic privacy risk strategy that spend privacy risk differently across visitor. We study how privacy risk budgets affect experimentation performance in two applications--website design and a recommendation system--under these strategies. For both strategies, we analytically find privacy risk budgets that optimally balance exploration and exploitation. We then extend the idea of an experiment-level privacy risk budget to a firm-wide privacy risk budget. We apply this firm-wide privacy risk budget in an empirical setting with 78 experiments. We find that the dynamic strategy is particularly valuable in longer and more complex experiments, and that optimizing the allocation of a firm-wide privacy risk budget across experiments substantially improves learning performance.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】企业通过在线实验（采用多臂老虎机模型）来个性化地向消费者展示内容，同时平衡探索行为与利用行为。然而，第三方可以通过观察消费者接收到的横幅、广告或推荐信息来推断消费者的潜在特征。为控制这种信息推断，我们提出了一种隐私风险预算机制，企业可以预先设定该预算，利用差分隐私技术来限制第三方的信息推断能力。为了使用这一隐私风险预算，我们设计了两种策略：一种是固定隐私风险策略，另一种是动态隐私风险策略，后者会根据访客的不同情况动态分配隐私风险。我们研究了在这些策略下，隐私风险预算如何影响两种应用场景（网站设计和推荐系统）中的实验效果。对于这两种策略，我们都通过分析找到了能够最佳平衡探索与利用行为的隐私风险预算值。随后，我们将实验层面的隐私风险预算概念扩展到了企业层面的隐私风险预算。我们在包含78个实验的实证研究中应用了这种企业层面的隐私风险预算机制。研究发现，在时间较长、结构较为复杂的实验中，动态隐私风险策略尤为有效；同时，优化企业层面隐私风险预算在各实验间的分配能够显著提升学习效果。。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: The Order of Binary Experiments under Endogenous Stopping
papers.abstract: We study the comparison of binary statistical experiments in large samples where information is acquired sequentially and the number of observations can depend on realized evidence. We introduce two orders. Stopping dominance compares experiments by their ability to reproduce the outcomes of arbitrary stopping policies, while decision dominance compares their value in finite decision problems with costly observations. Our main result shows that the two orders coincide and are characterized by coordinatewise dominance of the two directed Kullback--Leibler divergences. Moreover, strict dominance implies eventual strict value dominance in every decision problem in which learning the state can change the optimal action. The key result behind this characterization is an exact simulation theorem: any binary target experiment can be generated from repeated observations of a source experiment with expected sample sizes attaining the two KL lower bounds up to an additive constant that depends only on the source.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在大样本中进行的二元统计实验的比较问题，其中信息的获取是顺序进行的，且观测次数的多少可能取决于实际获得的证据。我们引入了两种排序方式：停止优势（Stopping Dominance）通过实验再现任意停止策略结果的能力来比较实验；决策优势（Decision Dominance）则通过实验在具有高成本观测的有限决策问题中的价值来进行比较。我们的主要研究结果表明，这两种排序方式是一致的，它们都可以通过两个有向Kullback-Leibler散度的逐坐标优势来表征。此外，严格优势意味着在每一个学习状态可能会改变最优行动的决策问题中，实验之间最终都会存在严格的价值优势。这一表征背后的关键结果是一个精确的模拟定理：任何二元目标实验都可以通过重复观测一个源实验来生成，该源实验的预期样本量能够达到这两个Kullback-Leibler散度下界，其差异仅取决于源实验本身，且这个差异是一个仅与源实验相关的加法常数。。研究方法：数值模拟、实验方法。

papers.title: Random Cap: Optimal Informationally Robust Delegation
papers.abstract: Are simple delegation rules optimal under ambiguity? We study delegation when the principal knows the mean, but not the distribution, of the agent's private information. In a quadratic constant-bias environment, the robustly optimal randomized mechanism is a random cap: the principal draws and reveals an upper bound below which the agent chooses freely. Randomization strictly outperforms every deterministic cap by hedging against cap-specific worst-case distributions. We characterize random caps through nondecreasing and concave expected-action rules and construct the solution using a saddle-point approach. The worst-case distribution features an exponential survival function over its continuous region and an atom at the upper endpoint. Under regularity conditions, the result extends to convex-order ambiguity. When the mean is below the agent's bias, the optimal mechanism additionally requires an incentive-neutral outcome lottery.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在信息模糊的情况下，简单的委托规则是否是最优的？我们研究了委托人知道代理人私人信息的均值但不知道其分布时的委托问题。在存在二次型常数偏差的环境中，鲁棒最优的随机机制是一种“随机上限”（random cap）：委托人随机抽取并公布一个上限，代理人可以在该上限以下自由选择行动。与任何确定性上限相比，随机化机制都能通过规避特定上限下的最坏情况分布而表现出更优的性能。我们通过非递减且凹性的期望效用规则来描述这种随机上限，并利用鞍点方法构建了相应的解决方案。在最坏情况下，代理人私人信息的分布在其连续区域内具有指数型的生存函数，并在分布的上端点处呈现一个离散的“原子值”（atom value）。在满足一定规则性的条件下，该结论可扩展到存在凸序模糊性的情况。当代理人的私人信息均值低于其自身偏见时，最优机制还需要包含一个激励中性的结果彩票机制。。研究方法：随机实验。

papers.title: The Influence of Investor Sentiment, Investor Overconfidence, and Investor Attention on the Risk of Stock Price Fall with Analyst Herding as a Moderating Variable in Southeast Asia
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: This study aims to analyze the influence of investor sentiment, investor overconfidence, and investor attention on stock price crash risk, as well as to examine the role of analyst herding behavior as a moderating variable among technology sector companies listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX), Singapore Exchange (SGX), Bursa Malaysia (KLSE), and the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) during the 2021–2025 period. The study employs a quantitative approach using secondary data obtained from financial statements, stock trading data, and corporate annual reports. The sample was determined using a saturated sampling technique, resulting in 468 observations. Stock price crash risk is proxied using Negative Conditional Skewness (NCSKEW) and Down-to-up Volatility (DUVOL). Data analysis was conducted using descriptive statistics, classical assumption tests, Moderated Regression Analysis (MRA), F-tests, t-tests, the coefficient of determination, and robustness tests. The research results indicate that investor sentiment, investor overconfidence, and investor attention do not significantly affect stock price crash risk, whether measured using the NCSKEW or DUVOL proxies. Furthermore, analyst herding does not moderate the relationship between these behavioral factors—investor sentiment, overconfidence, and attention—and stock price crash risk. Robustness tests employing both crash risk proxies and regression model comparisons yield consistent conclusions. These findings suggest that the examined investor behavioral factors fail to explain the variation in stock price crash risk among technology sector companies in Southeast Asia, implying the existence of other factors outside the research model that may influence such risk.
papers.summary_zh:
【风险管理与衍生品】本研究旨在分析投资者情绪、投资者过度自信以及投资者关注度对股价暴跌风险的影响，并探讨分析师从众行为在这些因素与股价暴跌风险之间的关系中所起到的调节作用。研究对象为2021至2025年间在印度尼西亚证券交易所（IDX）、新加坡证券交易所（SGX）、马来西亚证券交易所（KLSE）和泰国证券交易所（SET）上市的技术行业公司。研究采用定量方法，数据来源于财务报表、股票交易记录和企业年度报告等二手资料。样本选取采用饱和抽样技术，共获得468个观测值。股价暴跌风险通过负条件偏度（NCSKEW）和向下波动率（DUVOL）两个指标进行衡量。数据分析方法包括描述性统计分析、经典假设检验、调节回归分析（MRA）、F检验、t检验、决定系数以及稳健性检验。

研究结果表明，无论是使用NCSKEW还是DUVOL作为衡量指标，投资者情绪、投资者过度自信及投资者关注度均对股价暴跌风险没有显著影响。此外，分析师从众行为并未对这些行为因素与股价暴跌风险之间的关系产生调节作用。无论是基于股价暴跌风险的两种指标还是回归模型比较，稳健性检验均得出了一致的结果。这些发现表明，所研究的投资者行为因素无法解释东南亚技术行业...。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: The Energy Sustainability Advantage: Dynamic Connectedness and Portfolio Management Among Clean Energy, Crude Oil, and GCC Equity Markets
papers.venue: Review of Middle East Economics and Finance
papers.abstract: Abstract This paper examines the risk dependence between clean energy, oil prices and GCC stock markets over the period 2013–2023, covering the two recent events of the COVID-19 pandemic and Russia-Ukraine conflict. The main purpose is to investigate the volatility spillovers between clean energy, fossil fuel markets and GCC stock indices. We employ two methodologies namely the Diebold, F. X., and K. Yilmaz. 2012. “Better to Give than to Receive: Predictive Directional Measurement of Volatility Spillover.” International Journal of Forecasting 28: 57–66, Diebold, F. X., and K. Yilmaz. 2014. “On the Network Topology of Variance Decompositions: Measuring the Connectedness of Financial Firms.” Journal of Econometrics 182: 119–34, Diebold, F. X., and K. Yilmaz. 2015. “Trans-Atlantic Equity Volatility Connectedness: U.S. and European Financial Institutions, 2004-2014.” Journal of Financial Econometrics 14: 81–127 volatility spillover index and wavelet coherence analysis. The Diebold-Yilmaz connectedness results show that oil prices, KSA and Kuwait stock markets are net transmitters of shocks while the clean energy index and the stock markets of the UAE, Qatar, Bahrain and Oman are net receivers of volatility. The wavelet coherency findings reveal that the dependence between clean energy/oil prices and the stock markets varies across time scales and countries. Strong coherence is observed during the oil price crash and the COVID-19 crisis at low frequencies (high scales). The findings have several practical implications for investors and portfolio managers. The results suggest that GCC investors may benefit from including either clean energy or crude oil in their stock portfolios to reduce portfolio risk. The estimated hedge ratios indicate that both clean energy and crude oil can serve as effective hedging instruments. Moreover, the hedging effectiveness results show that incorporating clean energy, rather than crude oil, into stock portfolios leads to a greater reduction in portfolio risk.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】摘要：本文研究了2013年至2023年间清洁能源、油价与海湾合作委员会（GCC）股市之间的风险关联性，涵盖了COVID-19疫情和俄乌冲突这两大事件。研究的主要目的是探讨清洁能源市场、化石燃料市场与GCC股市指数之间的波动性溢出效应。我们采用了两种方法：Diebold、F. X.与K. Yilmaz于2012年提出的“给予优于接受：波动性溢出的预测性方向性测量”（“Better to Give than to Receive: Predictive Directional Measurement of Volatility Spillover”）方法，以及波动性溢出指数和小波一致性分析方法。研究结果表明，油价、沙特阿拉伯和科威特股市是波动性的净传递者，而清洁能源指数以及阿联酋、卡塔尔、巴林和阿曼的股市则是波动性的净接收者。小波一致性分析显示，清洁能源/油价与股市之间的关联性随时间尺度和国家不同而变化；在油价暴跌和COVID-19危机期间，低频（高尺度）下的关联性尤为显著。这些发现对投资者和投资组合管理者具有重要的实践意义：研究表明，GCC投资者可以通过在投资组合中加入清洁能源或原...。

papers.title: Digitalisation and Its Impact on Corporate ESG Performance in Middle East Countries
papers.venue: Journal of Economics, Finance and Accounting Studies
papers.abstract: Digitalisation, ESG (environment, social, and governance) practices have gained importance in recent years. Firms have to mandatorily implement initiatives for ESG. This paper examines digitalisation and corporate ESG performance in Middle East Countries. Digitalisation is about using digital and online methods to frame ESG metrics performance; provide information about ESG to regulatory authorities, and investors, and to track the corporate performance. Since ESG has three dimensions environment, social, and governance. This paper examines the impact of these three dimensions collectively and individually on firm performance, and attitude of investors and firm owners. Three hypothesis were drawn and tested. A panel data of 439 firms from fifteen Middle East countries was drawn and observations were made for 12 variables for the years 2013- 2023. Twelve value relevance models were created, tested, and the data was subjected to regression analysis using SPSS. The findings indicate that except for environment dimension, the other two dimensions give relevant information that digitalisation helps investors to take investment decisions, thereby impacting the firm market value significantly and positively. Digitalisation has a positive and significant relation with ESG performance.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】近年来，数字化以及环境、社会和治理（ESG）实践日益受到重视。企业必须强制实施与ESG相关的举措。本文研究了中东国家的数字化进程及其对企业ESG绩效的影响。数字化是指利用数字和在线手段来制定ESG指标、向监管机构和投资者提供相关信息，并跟踪企业的运营表现。由于ESG涵盖了环境、社会和治理三个维度，本文分别探讨了这三个维度对企业绩效以及投资者和企业所有者态度的综合与单独影响。研究提出了三个假设，并通过分析来自15个中东国家的439家企业的面板数据（涵盖2013至2023年的12个变量）进行了验证。研究人员构建了12个价值相关性模型，并使用SPSS软件对数据进行了回归分析。研究结果表明，除了环境维度外，其他两个维度均能提供有助于投资者做出投资决策的信息，从而显著且积极地影响企业的市场价值。数字化与企业的ESG绩效之间存在正向且显著的相关性。。研究方法：面板数据、回归分析。
